title: Do we need Attention? - Linear RNNs and State Space Models (SSMs) for NLP
summary: Sasha Rush surveys linear RNNs and state space models as replacements for attention in transformer-style models, in a talk for MLSys. It covers the foundational preliminaries and predates Mamba.
why: HN commenters recommend it for building intuition about state space models and the tradeoffs between transformer and SSM layers.

quote.text: I highly recommend Sasha Rush's video on it
